resources.name: Open-source electrostatic solver and particle tracer

access.notes: Any open-source software (e.g., FEniCS + scipy.integrate, or a custom electrostatic code) that can solve the Laplace equation for the tip–shield geometry and trace electron trajectories. The geometry and potentials are fully specified in the instruction.

resources.notes: Must handle axisymmetric geometry with a grounded shield and a biased tip, and track electrons of 69 eV energy.

resources.name: Monte Carlo electron transport code

access.notes: The agent must implement a Monte Carlo simulation of Auger electron elastic escape from Au, using screened Rutherford elastic scattering and Bethe stopping power. Standard Python scientific libraries (numpy, scipy) are sufficient.

resources.notes: The simulation needs only the material (Au), primary energy 132 eV, and Auger energy 69 eV.

resources.name: Python scientific stack
resources.notes: Required for numerical integration, interpolation, and file I/O.
